name: Acolyte
info: You devoted yourself to service in a temple or secluded in a sacred grove. There you performed rites as dictated by your religion. You might have served directly under a priest or studied your religion. Thanks to your priest's instruction and/or your own devotion, you also learned how to channel a modicum of divine power in service to your place of worship and the people who prayed there.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Calligrapher's Supplies}, {@item Book|Book (prayers)}, {@item Holy Symbol}, {@item Parchment} (10 sheets), {@item Robe}, 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Agent of the Ninth Quill
info: Your sharp mind and keen burgling skills led you to fall in with the Ninth Quill, a collective of thieves, saboteurs, and spies who steal magical lore and relics from others. Through your escapades—from purloining magic items and arcane tomes to sabotaging groups of mages—you've developed cunning skills and magical tricks to further your spy craft.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger}, {@item Light Hammer}, {@item Thieves' Tools}, {@item Iron Spike|Iron Spikes}, {@item Rope}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 17 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Archaeologist
info: You've made a lifelong study of the lost and fallen cultures of the past, visiting their ruins, deciphering their written records, and examining their surviving masterworks. Perhaps you studied at a university or institution, supplementing your time in the library with fieldwork in remote locations. Some archaeologists plunder the treasures of the past in search of wealth or fame, but most consider it their calling to learn from the past. In any case, you combine the qualities of learned historians with the grit of treasure hunters.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Mason's Tools}, {@item Bullseye Lantern}, {@item Map}, {@item Map or Scroll Case}, {@item Shovel}, {@item Tent}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 17 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Archivist
info: You spent your formative years in a great vault, repository, or subterranean archive dedicated to preserving history. The ages bring flotsam of artifacts and forgotten lore to such halls, and you've spent many a restless night studying trinkets and scrolls. Your mind was sharpened in the archives, and you're ready to put your knowledge to use.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Quarterstaff}, {@item Calligrapher's Supplies}, {@item Book} (history), {@item Parchment} (8 sheets), {@item Robe}, 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Artisan
info: You began mopping floors and scrubbing counters in an artisan's workshop for a few coppers per day as soon as you were strong enough to carry a bucket. When you were old enough to apprentice, you learned to create basic crafts of your own, as well as how to sweet-talk the occasional demanding customer. Your trade has also given you a keen eye for detail.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Artisan's Tools} (same as above), 2 {@item Pouch|Pouches}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 32 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Academy Unseen Spy
info: Publicly, you're a courtier, a mediator, or an entertainer. But behind that glamorous visage is a mind honed for gathering secrets. Trained by the enchanters of the Academy Unseen, you know how to use your charm and wit (plus a little magic) to infiltrate organizations, uncover information, and broker deals.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Disguise Kit}, {@item Fine Clothes}, {@item Perfume}, 5 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Caretaker
info: You've always had a level head and a knack for helping in dire situations. Perhaps you were raised in a large, busy family, or perhaps a crisis occurred when you were young that you jumped to solve. Once older, you tutored under a folk healer, learning how to identify healing herbs and how to apply medicine and care to all you meet.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Quarterstaff}, {@item Herbalism Kit}, {@item Bedroll}, {@item Book} (philosophy), {@item Lamp}, {@item Oil} (3 flasks), {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Charlatan
info: Once you were old enough to order an ale, you soon had a favorite stool in every tavern within ten miles of where you were born. As you traveled the circuit from public house to watering hole, you learned to prey on unfortunates who were in the market for a comforting lie or two—perhaps a sham potion or forged ancestry records.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Forgery Kit}, {@item Costume}, {@item Fine Clothes}, 15 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Freebooter
info: Though most youths where you grew up accepted compulsory military service or rigid local rule, you bristled at that attempt to control your life. You forsook your allegiance, discarded your given name, and signed on as a freebooter with the first coastal vessel that would have you. Since then, you've worked the island chains and coastal ports—never straying far from land, but building deep local connections and a breadth of hard-won experience.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger}, {@item Weaver's Tools}, {@item Backpack}, {@item Ball Bearing|Ball Bearings}, Basket, {@item Bedroll}, {@item Bucket}, {@item Ration|Rations} (3 days' worth), {@item Rope}, {@item Signal Whistle}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 38 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Cook
info: You practically grew up in a kitchen, helping elders by preparing meals from a very young age. You've become familiar with many ingredients, and have developed an innate intuition on how to combine them into delicious dishes. Perhaps you've found work in a restaurant in a village or roadside inn.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) 1 {@item Book} (recipes), {@item Cook's Utensils}, {@item Fine Clothes}, {@item Oil} (3 flasks), {@item Iron Pot}, 6 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Experiment of the First One
info: Your body has been warped by the transmutation practices of the Esoteric Order of the First One. Perhaps you were inadvertently caught up in one of the organization's experiments, or maybe you were a member of the organization and sought to improve your physical form through magical might. Whatever the case, you use your strange anatomy to your benefit.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Artisan's Tools} (same as above), {@item Backpack}, {@item Robe}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 30 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Necromancer Recruit
info: Death has always fascinated you. You've studied that morbid topic alongside members of a necromantic cult, analyzing the macabre with scientific precision. Through these studies, you've amassed knowledge of medication, necromancy, and history.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger}, {@item Herbalism Kit}, {@item Book} (anatomy), {@item Shovel}, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Criminal
info: You eked out a living in dark alleyways, cutting purses or burgling shops. Perhaps you were part of a small gang of like-minded wrongdoers who looked out for each other. Or maybe you were a lone wolf, fending for yourself against the local thieves' guild and more fearsome lawbreakers.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger|2 Daggers}, {@item Thieves' Tools}, {@item Crowbar}, {@item Pouch|2 Pouches}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Storm Chaser
info: Your daredevil tendencies and thirst for excitement led you to a circle of mages and thrill-seekers dedicated to studying natural and magical catastrophes. From shaping molten glass to charging into a hurricane's eye, you thrive when disaster is mere steps away.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Glassblower's Tools}, {@item Backpack}, {@item Rope}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 15 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Dead Magic Dweller
info: The dead magic zones of the world are anathema to spellcasters and monsters that rely on magic—which is exactly why you made your life there. Perhaps you're on the run from relentless hunters, or you ran afoul of a vengeful archmage or genie. Whatever the case, you decided that living in a dead zone was your best option. After long months or years, you're stronger, wiser, and armed with hard-earned knowledge of field medicine and wasteland survival.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Greatclub}, {@item Leatherworker's Tools}, {@item Bedroll}, {@item Blanket}, {@item Healer's Kit}, {@item Pole}, {@item Ration|Rations} (3 days' worth), {@item Tent}, {@item Tinderbox}, 5 {@item Torch|Torches}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, {@item Waterskin}, 32 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Dragon Cultist
info: You are an initiate of the Dragon Cult. You discovered or were brought to a cell cult, where you exemplified the values honored by dragon cultists: duplicity, secrecy, and determination. In exchange for your oath to serve the cult, the cult offered you the company of fellow dragon worshipers, plus access to resources that might help further your studies in the realms of arcana and occultism.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Poisoner's Kit}, {@item Dagger}, {@item Glass Bottle}, {@item Lamp}, {@item Manacles}, {@item Oil} (5 flasks), 2 {@item Pouch|Pouches}, {@item Robe}, {@item Rope}, 30 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Emerald Enclave Caretaker
info: As a Caretaker with the Emerald Enclave, you take care of those who care for the world. Either alongside your fellow Enclave members or by yourself, you've learned essential skills for living with the land: how to track game, where to forage for useful herbs, and even how to forecast the weather. You use these talents to maintain the balance between civilization and the wilds and to rid the world of unnatural creatures.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Shortbow}, {@item Arrow|20 Arrows}, {@item Herbalism Kit}, {@item Bedroll}, {@item Blanket}, {@item Pouch}, {@item Tent}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 13 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Entertainer
info: You spent much of your youth following roving fairs and carnivals, performing odd jobs for musicians and acrobats in exchange for lessons. You may have learned how to walk a tightrope, how to play a lute in a distinct style, or how to recite poetry with impeccable diction. To this day, you thrive on applause and long for the stage.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Musical Instrument} (same as above), {@item Costume|2 Costumes}, {@item Mirror}, {@item Perfume}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 11 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Familiar Trainer
info: A magical familiar bonded with you when you were young, accompanying you throughout your adolescence. Now, you can't imagine life without your furry—or feathery, scaly, or slimy—friend at your side. You've learned to work in tandem with your familiar, and when adventure presents its challenges, your familiar is quick to remind you of the small joys in life.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Quarterstaff}, {@item Musical Instrument} (same as above), {@item Bedroll}, {@item Bell}, {@item String}, {@item Tinderbox}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, {@item Waterskin}, 44 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Farmer
info: You grew up close to the land. Years tending animals and cultivating the earth rewarded you with patience and good health. You have a keen appreciation for nature's bounty alongside a healthy respect for nature's wrath.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Sickle}, {@item Carpenter's Tools}, {@item Healer's Kit}, {@item Iron Pot}, {@item Shovel}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 30 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Fisher
info: You have spent your life aboard fishing boats on a large river or inland sea. Perhaps you were taught by your family, or maybe you decided to start fishing to help feed your village. Regardless of how you began, you soon fell in love with the water, the art of fishing, and the promise of the eternal horizon.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Bedroll}, {@item Dagger}, {@item Fishing Tackle}, {@item Cook's Utensils}, {@item Net}, {@item Trident}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 12 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Guard
info: You once served as a guard, where you learned how to preempt trouble with your intimidating stare and, when necessary, absorb deadly blows. Guards, active or retired, have to be tough, resilient fighters against the dangers of the world, and you seek to maintain that reputation.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Mace}, {@item Smith's Tools}, {@item Fine Clothes}, {@item Manacles}, {@item Portable Ram}, 4 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Town Watch
info: Your feet ache when you remember the countless hours you spent at your post in the tower. You were trained to keep one eye looking outside the wall, watching for marauders sweeping from the nearby forest, and your other eye looking inside the wall, searching for cutpurses and troublemakers.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Spear}, {@item Light Crossbow}, 20 {@item Crossbow Bolt|Bolts}, {@item Gaming Set} (same as above), {@item Hooded Lantern}, {@item Manacles}, {@item Quiver}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 12 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Wanderer
info: You came of age outdoors, far from settled lands. Your home was anywhere you chose to spread your bedroll. There are wonders in the wilderness—strange monsters, pristine forests and streams, overgrown ruins of great halls—and you learned to fend for yourself as you explored them. From time to time, you guided friendly nature priests who instructed you in the fundamentals of channeling the magic of the wild.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Shortbow}, {@item Arrow|20 Arrows}, {@item Cartographer's Tools}, {@item Bedroll}, {@item Quiver}, {@item Tent}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 3 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Songbird
info: You accepted an invitation to join the Songbirds, pledging an oath to uphold the clandestine code of the Songbirds and act in service to the common good. Like all Songbirds, you understand the value of teamwork as well as when it's best to go it alone. Songbird veterans have taught you the order's secrets—magical melodies, special watchwords, and legerdemain—and have entrusted you to use such knowledge to surveil and undermine the forces of evil.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Disguise Kit}, {@item Bedroll}, {@item Costume}, {@item Grappling Hook}, {@item Rope}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 14 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Haunted One
info: You are haunted by the events of your past. Whether it was a lone terrible incident or an accumulation of painful moments, you bear the unshakable weight of what happened to you. You've tried to bury it and run away from it, to no avail; it can't be slain with a sword or banished via magic. Nevertheless, you persist.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Woodcarver's Tools}, {@item Crowbar}, {@item Holy Water} (1 {@item flask}), {@item Mirror}, {@item Oil} (2 {@item flask|flasks}), {@item Signal Whistle}, {@item Tinderbox}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 5 {@item Torch|Torches}, {@item Waterskin}, and 14 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Hermit
info: You spent your early years secluded in a hut or monastery located well beyond the outskirts of the nearest settlement. In those days, your only companions were the creatures of the forest and those who would occasionally visit to bring news of the outside world and supplies. The solitude allowed you to spend many hours pondering the mysteries of creation.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Quarterstaff}, {@item Woodcarver's Tools}, {@item Bedroll}, {@item Book} (philosophy), {@item Lamp}, {@item Oil} (3 flasks), {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 20 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Horizon Weaver
info: Your adolescence was marked by unquenchable wanderlust. You left home and began your travels as soon as you were able. Along the way, you encountered adventurous conjurers, who taught you some of the teleportation magic needed to further your explorations.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Shortbow}, {@item Arrow|20 Arrows}, {@item Weaver's Tools}, {@item Map}, {@item Quiver}, {@item Rope}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 18 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: House Agent
info: You are connected to one of the great merchant or noble houses. You might be a member of the family by birth or an employee of the house with no familial connection. You've earned your living by doing the business of the house, serving as the hands, feet, and eyes of house leadership in the world. You might have many old friends, mentors, and rivals in the house you serve, plus allies or enemies in other houses.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Artisan's Tools} (same as above), {@item Fine Clothes}, 20 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Ice Fisher
info: You come from a proud line of ice fishers from the frozen northern reaches. Hauling catches through thick lake ice isn't the most glorious trade, but it's an honest living. You've trained your senses for the slightest tug on the line, wrestled massive cold-water fish out of ice-covered lakes, and gutted enough catches to feed your village many times over. These experiences have toughened your body and mind for a life of adventuring.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Woodcarver's Tools}, Basket, {@item Block and Tackle}, {@item Chain}, {@item Hunting Trap}, {@item Net}, {@item Pole}, {@item Ration|Rations} (3 days' worth), {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 32 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Innkeeper
info: You spent your youth scrubbing floors and counters in a wayside inn, and you soon became a popular fixture. You were taken under the wing of the owner, and were taught how to run the business and sweet talk your patrons. You've even learned a few tunes to entertain patrons.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Brewer's Supplies}, {@item Fine Clothes}, 3 {@item Glass Bottle|Glass Bottles}, {@item Iron Pot}, {@item Oil} (3 flasks), 6 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Inquisitive
info: You have honed your talents of investigation and deduction—fueled by a boundless curiosity—to explore mysteries, find missing people, recover stolen goods, unearth corruption and conspiracies, and solve crimes. As an inquisitive, you might have pursued freelance work, signed on with an agency, reported for a broadsheet, or worked for the guards.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Thieves' Tools}, {@item Bullseye Lantern}, {@item Crowbar}, {@item Oil} (10 flasks), {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 10 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Knight of the Pale Guard
info: Not all who answer the call of a higher power are content to pore over scripture in a stuffy temple. You chose the path of the holy warrior by joining the Pale Guard. As a knight of the Pale, you exercise righteous scorn for the forces of evil, unswerving camaraderie for your siblings in arms, and heartfelt compassion for the survivors of war. With weapon and holy symbol in hand, you've sworn not to rest until the light of justice has vanquished the shadow of chaos across the land.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Spear}, {@item Smith's Tools}, {@item Bullseye Lantern}, {@item Holy Symbol}, {@item Manacles}, {@item Oil} (5 flasks), {@item Tinderbox}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 9 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Lords' Alliance Vassal
info: You've pledged your loyalty to a member-city of the Lords' Alliance. As an Alliance agent, you must uphold the tenets of the Alliance and seek to increase safety and prosperity throughout the lands. You're sworn to bring honor and glory to your lord's house, whether that means securing trade roads for a merchant-lord or vanquishing monsters threatening a frontier settlement. You've trained in the arts of swordplay and statecraft and are as deft with a blade as you are with a quill.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) 2 {@item Javelin|Javelins}, {@item Painter's Supplies}, {@item Fine Clothes}, {@item Ink}, 5 {@item Ink Pen|Ink Pens}, {@item Parchment} (9 sheets), 13 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Merchant
info: You were apprenticed to a trader, caravan master, or shopkeeper, learning the fundamentals of commerce. You traveled broadly, and you earned a living by buying and selling the raw materials artisans need to craft or finished works from such crafters. You might have transported goods from one place to another (by ship, wagon, or caravan) or bought them from traveling traders and sold them in your own shop.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Navigator's Tools}, {@item Pouch|2 Pouches}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 22 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Mist Wanderer
info: You once knew your home. But one day, the Mists Between Worlds rose and drew you away. Ever since, you have wandered between realms, braving the mercurial Mists as you search for a way home. Your time in these strange unmoored realms has changed you, yet you find solace in communities of fellow wanderers.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Artisan's Tools} (same as above), {@item Lamp}, {@item Oil} (5 flasks), {@item Pouch}, {@item Rope}, {@item Tinderbox}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, and 30 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Moonwell Pilgrim
info: You grew up revering mysterious shrines called moonwells. As a moonwell pilgrim, you undertook a quest to visit and commune with every moonwell near your home. Along your idyllic journeys, you collected a repertoire of Faerie folk songs, painted landscapes of enchanting vistas, and even learned how to wield a bit of primal magic.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Quarterstaff}, {@item Painter's Supplies}, {@item Bedroll}, {@item Bell}, {@item Pouch}, {@item Robe}, {@item String}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, {@item Waterskin}, 38 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Tomb Raider
info: You grew up among the monuments of an ancient desert empire, raised on stories of fallen dynasties and buried cities. In these tales, your homeland once overflowed with riches—priceless relics left hidden beneath the sands for anyone cunning and brave enough to seek them out. You've taken it upon yourself to explore its crypts, tombs, and pyramids to reclaim your people's treasures.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger}, {@item Light Hammer}, {@item Mason's Tools}, {@item Backpack}, {@item Bedroll}, {@item Crowbar}, {@item Ladder}, {@item Pole}, 2 {@item Pouch|Pouches}, {@item Rope}, {@item String}, {@item Tinderbox}, 5 {@item Torch|Torches}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, {@item Waterskin}, 26 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Starkeeper
info: Starstones are sources of great magical power that can alter the Weave or even the very nature of reality. Most were constructed in antiquity, and many have since been damaged or gone dormant. As a starkeeper, you roam Aerth in search of ruined places of power, hoping to learn more about the history and powers of starstones—or even restore a malfunctioning one.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Quarterstaff}, {@item Jeweler's Tools}, {@item Perfume}, {@item Pouch}, {@item Robe}, {@item Shovel}, {@item String}, {@item Waterskin}, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Noble
info: You were raised in a noble house, surrounded by wealth, power, and privilege. Your family of minor aristocrats ensured that you received a first-class education, some of which you appreciated and some of which you resented. Your time in the castle, especially the many hours you spent observing your family at court, also taught you a great deal about leadership.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Gaming Set} (same as above), {@item Fine Clothes}, {@item Perfume}, 29 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Circus Trouper
info: Whether as a performer or a circus hand, you found a home among the members of the Circus Pandaemonia. As you traveled across the world bringing magic and wonder to excited audiences, you learned some magic and honed your talents for performance and misdirection.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Disguise Kit}, {@item Gaming Set} (any), {@item Costume}, {@item Mirror}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 12 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Lionsguard Squire
info: You've pledged your life to the defense of Capital and sought admission to the city's order of elite warriors: the Lionsguard. But before you have the chance to join the ranks officially, you must first serve as a squire. You've found a liege willing to take you on and teach you the order's ways. Will you uphold the Lionsguard ideals of glory, honor, and strength and prove yourself worthy of knighthood?

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Spear}, {@item Leatherworker's Tools}, {@item Fine Clothes}, 9 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Highland Wanderer
info: You spent years wandering nearby barren highlands. Perhaps a great plain patrolled by roving dragons or a dangerous windswept heath dotted with ancient obelisks enchanted to imprison Fiends. Friendships are hard to find in such an isolated land, and you've learned to keep strangers at a distance.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Cartographer's Tools}, {@item Backpack}, {@item Bedroll}, {@item Hooded Lantern}, {@item Oil} (3 flasks), {@item Rope}, {@item Tinderbox}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, {@item Waterskin}, 23 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Sage
info: You spent your formative years traveling between manors and monasteries, performing various odd jobs and services in exchange for access to their libraries. You whiled away many a long evening studying books and scrolls, learning the lore of the multiverse—even the rudiments of magic—and your mind yearns for more.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Quarterstaff}, {@item Calligrapher's Supplies}, {@item Book} (history), {@item Parchment} (8 sheets), {@item Robe}, 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Sailor
info: You lived as a seafarer, wind at your back and decks swaying beneath your feet. You were raised alongside experienced sailors (or brigands), and you've perched on barstools in more ports of call than you can remember, faced mighty storms, and swapped stories with folk who live beneath the waves.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger}, {@item Navigator's Tools}, {@item Rope}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 20 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Scribe
info: You spent formative years in a scriptorium, a monastery dedicated to the preservation of knowledge, or a government agency, where you learned to write with a clear hand and produce finely written texts. Perhaps you scribed government documents or copied tomes of literature. You might have some skill as a writer of poetry, narrative, or scholarly research. Above all, you have a careful attention to detail, helping you avoid introducing mistakes to the documents you copy and create.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Calligrapher's Supplies}, {@item Fine Clothes}, {@item Lamp}, {@item Oil} (3 flasks), {@item Parchment} (12 sheets), 23 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Seer Apprentice
info: As an apprentice to a Seer, you learned to interpret minor omens from the clouds above, the fires within, or the fathoms below. You traveled to many libraries to further your education, and you now travel across the world, imparting advice and aid to others.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Navigator's Tools}, 8 {@item Candle|Candles}, {@item Ink}, {@item Ink Pen}, {@item Parchment} (9 sheets), {@item Pouch}, {@item Tinderbox}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 11 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Exiled Talon
info: You trained your whole life to become a member of the Talons, a mysterious thieves' guild that controls much illegal activity from behind the scenes. Stealth and quick reflexes were just the start of your Talon education; you also needed to hone your ruthlessness to ensure the safety of the guild's secrets. But one wrong move led to your expulsion from the order. Now you must walk your own path.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger|2 Daggers}, {@item Thieves' Tools}, {@item Caltrops}, {@item Costume}, {@item Grappling Hook}, {@item Iron Spike|Iron Spikes}, {@item Mirror}, 2 {@item Pouch|Pouches}, {@item Rope}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 3 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Fell Expert
info: You are from the Shadowfell or have studied it extensively. It's a gloomy shadow of the Material Realm perpetually lit by grey light. You might survive the Shadowfell's merciless conditions with your wit and cunning, or keep threats at bay with your brawn and bravery. You believe that knowing who to trust and who to keep at arm's length isn't just practical—it's often a matter of life or death.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger}, {@item Glassblower's Tools}, {@item Backpack}, {@item Hunting Trap}, {@item Lamp}, {@item Oil} (3 flasks), {@item Traveler's Clothes}, {@item Waterskin}, 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Soldier
info: You began training for war as soon as you reached adulthood and carry precious few memories of life before you took up arms. Battle is in your blood. Sometimes you catch yourself reflexively performing the basic fighting exercises you learned first. Eventually, you put that training to use on the battlefield, protecting the realm by waging war.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Spear}, {@item Shortbow}, {@item Arrow|20 Arrows}, {@item Gaming Set} (same as above), {@item Healer's Kit}, {@item Quiver}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 14 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Spellfire Initiate
info: You bear the gift of spellfire: a rare form of magic that channels the raw power of the Weave. Wielding spellfire takes a heavy toll on the body. You've trained both mind and body to efficiently wield this sacred power.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Alchemist's Supplies}, {@item Arcane Focus} ({@item Arcane Focus, Crystal|Crystal} or {@item Arcane Focus, Wand|Wand}), 2 {@item Pouch|Pouches}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 36 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Ward of the Sheltering Hands
info: A turn of ill luck led you to the Sheltering Hands, an altruistic organization dedicated to defending the downtrodden. The organization helped you regain your footing and taught you some of its protective magic—in the hope that one day you too would shelter the less fortunate in their time of need.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Cook's Utensils}, {@item Blanket}, {@item Healer's Kit}, {@item Lamp}, {@item Oil} (3 flasks), {@item Tinderbox}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, {@item Waterskin}, 40 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Scavenger
info: You grew up on the streets surrounded by similarly ill-fated castoffs, a few of them friends and a few of them rivals. You slept where you could and did odd jobs for food. At times, when the hunger became unbearable, you resorted to theft. Still, you never lost your pride and never abandoned hope. Fate is not yet finished with you.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger|2 Daggers}, {@item Thieves' Tools}, {@item Gaming Set} (any), {@item Bedroll}, {@item Pouch|2 Pouches}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Court of Owls Mercenary
feat: {@feat Novice of the Court of Owls}
info: Maybe you needed the money. Maybe you longed for a family, no matter how dubious. Or maybe you're just good at getting the job done by any means necessary. Whatever your reason, you enlisted with the Court of Owls, a notorious mercenary guild and shadowy syndicate. Though the Court's leaders insist the organization is more like a family than a shadowy syndicate, few families exhibit as much dishonesty, nepotism, and corruption as this one. You've honed your cunning, reflexes, and blade to climb the guild's ranks.

items.name: Feat:
items.entry: {@feat Novice of the Court of Owls}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Club}, {@item Dagger}, {@item Forgery Kit}, {@item Fine Clothes}, {@item Hooded Lantern}, {@item Oil} (3 flasks), 2 {@item Pouch|Pouches}, {@item String}, {@item Tinderbox}, 11 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Bouncer
info: You kept the peace in a rowdy alehouse, a dockside gambling den, or a fighting pit where the house always wanted its cut. Most nights you settled things with a hard look; the rest, you settled with your fists, a bar stool, or whatever was within reach. You learned to read a room for trouble before it started, and you know that the fight usually goes to whoever throws the first chair.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Club}, {@item Gaming Set} (same as above), {@item Manacles}, {@item Lamp}, {@item Oil} (2 flasks), {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 42 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Quartermaster
info: You kept a company fed, whether a mercenary band, a garrison on a lonely frontier, or a caravan crossing hard country. You haggled with farmers for every sack of grain, stretched thin rations through long winters, and learned that a hot meal at the end of a bad day does more for morale than any speech. Soldiers and travelers alike remember the one who fed them.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Spear}, {@item Cook's Utensils}, {@item Backpack}, {@item Iron Pot}, {@item Ration|Rations} (5 days' worth), {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 39 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Runner
info: You carried messages, packages, and the occasional stolen secret across a sprawling city, and the streets were always too slow. You learned every gutter, ledge, and laundry line between the districts, and you could cross half the city without touching the ground. Guards, rival couriers, and angry clients have all chased you; few of them have kept up.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger}, {@item Cartographer's Tools}, {@item Grappling Hook}, {@item Map or Scroll Case}, {@item Rope}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 27 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Dragon Hunter
info: You tracked serpents and their brood through scorched valleys, poisoned swamps, and frozen peaks. Maybe you were hired muscle for a wyrm-slaying company, or maybe a dragon took everything from you and you went looking for it. Your experience with dragons and their abilities has left you changed: your weapons now take on the elements of your quarry, and their fury no longer burns you as it once did.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Spear}, {@item Leatherworker's Tools}, {@item Hunting Trap}, {@item Rope}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 36 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Crystal Scholar
info: You studied under a gem dragon or one of its devoted circles, learning to focus your thoughts through cut crystal until the mind itself becomes a tool. Your teachers valued discipline and self-knowledge and some of their power took root in you.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Quarterstaff}, {@item Jeweler's Tools}, {@item Pouch}, {@item Robe}, 23 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Dragonbank Ward
info: You were raised or sworn into service of one of the Dragon Banks run by a metallic dragon. You might have protected property, collected debts, forged bank guardians, or just kept the long records of commerce. A spark of the Bank's power now lives in you.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Mace}, {@item Smith's Tools}, {@item Holy Symbol}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 18 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Dragonsworn Zealot
info: While the Dragon Cult's whisperers and spies work in the shadows, you serve as one of its claws. Your devotion was rewarded: whether you still serve the cult, or have fled it with its gift still burning in your blood, a sliver of draconic power was bestowed on you.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Mace}, {@item Smith's Tools}, {@item Holy Symbol} (draconic idol), {@item Robe}, 19 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Heretic
info: You once belonged to an established faith, but your beliefs strayed from its doctrine. Perhaps you found a forbidden text that contradicted the church's teachings, worshiped a god your order declared false, or simply asked one question too many. Branded a heretic, you were cast out or forced into hiding, and you learned to quote scripture convincingly while keeping your true convictions to yourself.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Forgery Kit}, {@item Book|Book (forbidden scripture)}, {@item Holy Symbol}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 3 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Gladiator
info: You fought for coin, freedom, or glory in fighting pits or grand arenas, where surviving the bout was only half the job—the other half was giving the crowd something to cheer for. Years of trading blows before roaring stands taught you both disciplined martial technique and a showman's timing.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Spear}, {@item Net}, {@item Gaming Set} (same as above), {@item Costume}, {@item Healer's Kit}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 35 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Duelist
info: You trained in fencing halls, private academies, or back-alley proving grounds, studying footwork, blade maintenance, and the telltale habits of opponents. Whether you fought for honor, patronage, or wagers, you treat combat as a craft.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger}, {@item Smith's Tools}, {@item Fine Clothes}, {@item Perfume}, 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Outlander
info: You grew up in untamed highlands, deep forests, or wind-scoured steppes far from walled cities, where beasts and ancient magics still shape the land. Living among hunters and herders toughened your body, and a brush with primordial power left an echo of magical might in your strikes.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Handaxe}, 2 {@item Javelin|Javelins}, {@item Leatherworker's Tools}, {@item Bedroll}, {@item Hunting Trap}, {@item Tent}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, {@item Waterskin}, 29 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Runecarver
info: You apprenticed in the old craft of inscribing sigils of power into fired clay, stone tablets, or ritual vessels. Between tending the kiln and studying weathered monoliths, you learned to coax lingering magic from carved symbols and to carry that ancient language into the wider world.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Light Hammer}, {@item Potter's Tools}, {@item Book} (runes), {@item Pouch}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 10 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Pilgrim
info: You walked hundreds of miles along dusty roads and mountain passes to visit distant shrines, sanctuaries, and sacred sites. Somewhere on that long road, a higher power took notice of your devotion and answered with a spark of divine favor.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Quarterstaff}, {@item Cobbler's Tools}, {@item Bedroll}, {@item Blanket}, {@item Holy Symbol}, {@item Ration|Rations} (5 days' worth), {@item Traveler's Clothes}, {@item Waterskin}, 33 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Tower Mage
info: You were inducted into an established order of spellcasters—one whose traditions divide magical practice into distinct philosophies, alignments, or robes. Years of structured study, strict examination, and copying arcane treatises shaped both your discipline and the distinctive signature of your spells.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Quarterstaff}, {@item Calligrapher's Supplies}, {@item Arcane Focus} ({@item Arcane Focus, Crystal|Crystal} or {@item Arcane Focus, Wand|Wand}), {@item Ink}, {@item Ink Pen}, {@item Parchment} (10 sheets), {@item Robe}, 18 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Cavalier Squire
info: You served as squire to a knight of a chivalric order, tending warhorses, mending tack and harness, and learning the heraldry and histories of noble houses. You learned how to ride hard, honor your vows, and strike true when the moment calls for courage.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Spear}, {@item Leatherworker's Tools}, {@item Fine Clothes}, {@item Bedroll}, {@item Rope}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 25 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Monster Hunter
info: You tracked creatures of the night across fogbound roads and forgotten crypts. Whether you learned your trade from a seasoned hunter or through bitter necessity, you know how to read signs of the unnatural, prepare alchemical wards and oils, and put down horrors that refuse to stay buried.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger}, {@item Alchemist's Supplies}, {@item Hooded Lantern}, {@item Oil} (3 flasks), {@item Rope}, {@item Tinderbox}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 10 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Escaped Thrall
info: You once served a powerful master—a hag, archfey, dark mage, vampire, or other predator—as a captive attendant, courier, or test subject before breaking free of their grasp. Years spent surviving beneath a dangerous gaze taught you how to read sudden shifts in mood, mask your face when fleeing pursuit, and pocket vials for restorative brews whenever the chance arose.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger}, {@item Disguise Kit}, 2 {@item Vial|Vials}, {@item Hooded Lantern}, {@item Oil} (2 flasks), {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 14 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Tinker
info: You grew up taking apart locks, lanterns, music boxes, and wind-up curiosities just to see how they worked. Whether you kept a cluttered workshop or pushed a rattling repair cart from town to town, you have nimble fingers and an eye for every flaw in a mechanism.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Light Hammer}, {@item Tinker's Tools}, {@item Bullseye Lantern}, {@item Oil} (3 flasks), {@item Pouch|2 Pouches}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 12 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Sapper
info: You worked in siege trenches, deep mines, or demolition crews, shoring up tunnels, disarming snares, and bringing down fortifications that armies couldn't storm. Dirty, hazardous labor hardened your body and taught you how structures stand—and the fastest way to bring them crashing down.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Light Hammer}, {@item Tinker's Tools}, {@item Crowbar}, {@item Iron Spike|Iron Spikes}, {@item Shovel}, {@item Tinderbox}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 10 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Apothecary
info: You learned your trade among drying racks, alembics, and labeled drawers of ingredients. Neighbors, travelers, and wounded soldiers alike came to your counter for your remedies and steady hands, giving you both practical medical skill and a familiarity with natural remedies.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Alchemist's Supplies}, {@item Healer's Kit}, 3 {@item Vial|Vials}, {@item Pouch}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 10 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Bounty Hunter
info: You made your living tracking fugitives, debtors, and dangerous marks across city rooftops and lonely frontier roads. Bringing a target in taught you to prepare venoms or sedatives to tilt the odds in your favor and to attack without remorse, when necessary.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger}, {@item Poisoner's Kit}, {@item Manacles}, {@item Rope}, {@item Hooded Lantern}, {@item Oil} (2 flasks), {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 10 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Courier
info: You carried sealed dispatches and valuables along post roads and mountain trails, riding hard or running on foot when a mount couldn't follow. Long miles taught you how to keep pace through any weather, coax stamina from tired horses, and spot trouble along the road ahead.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Dagger}, {@item Cobbler's Tools}, {@item Backpack}, {@item Bedroll}, {@item Map or Scroll Case}, {@item Ration|Rations} (4 days' worth), {@item Traveler's Clothes}, {@item Waterskin}, 35 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Shipwright
info: You spent years in noisy shipyards or riverside drydocks, shaping timber, caulking seams, and raising masts built to survive the open sea. Hauling heavy beams built your strength, while inspecting hulls for rot and hairline cracks trained your eyes to spot trouble before it can damage a vessel.

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Handaxe}, {@item Carpenter's Tools}, {@item Block and Tackle}, {@item Crowbar}, {@item Rope}, {@item Traveler's Clothes}, 31 GP; or (B) 50 GP
